item.title: ‘One Battle After Another’s’ Michael Bauman Wins British Society of Cinematographers Feature Film Award
item.description: “One Battle After Another” cinematographer Michael Bauman has won the British Society of Cinematographers Award for best cinematography in a feature film. This is Bauman’s first win and nomination at the BSC Awards. He triumphed over “Die My Love” (Seamus McGarvey), “Marty Supreme” (Darius Khondji), “Sinners” (Autumn Arkapaw Arkapaw) and “Frankenstein” (Dan Lausten). When Bauman joined Variety […]

item.title: Washington Post Publisher and CEO Will Lewis Steps Down Following Layoffs
item.description: Days after The Washington Post laid off nearly one-third of its staff, the outlet’s publisher and CEO, Will Lewis, has stepped down.
